notes: intercept large -> fidelity/collector/sync bug, not staleness.
slope large with r2 > 0.5 -> error is mainly explained by AoI.
Samples below min_real_mbps are discarded to avoid divide-by-near-zero relative error.

units.real: Mbps from direct collector host rxRate
units.staleness_error_slope: Mbps absolute error per second of AoI
